title: 贝莱德Egon：AI基建第二层，拉美与印度才是新兴市场底牌？
speaker: Egon Vavric

segments.en: Yes, so if you go back a little bit more on the AI infrastructure story as well, I mean really proud of the managing capital for Black clients, investing in Latin American EM here from Hong Kong and in the main reason we feel is actually the right place to have exposure to those geographies because the core commodity is going into the AI infrastructure as well coming out from emerging market economies.
segments.zh: 回到AI基础设施这条主线，我们很自豪能在香港为贝莱德客户管理拉美新兴市场的配置。我们认为配置这些地区是合适的，因为进入AI基础设施的核心大宗商品，同样来自新兴市场经济体。

segments.en: So if you look at industrial methods overall, EM and Latin America region deliver 80% to 90% of core components.
segments.zh: 看整体工业环节，新兴市场和拉美地区提供了80%到90%的核心组件。

segments.en: So you have a second layer on the AI infrastructure build out which can benefit.
segments.zh: 所以在AI基础设施建设中，还有第二层可以受益。

segments.en: The other, additionally I mean I haven't talked too much about different regions, we went through I think the second quarter where ex tech earnings revisions start to match tech earnings revisions.
segments.zh: 另外，我还没怎么谈不同地区。我们经历了第二季度，非科技板块的盈利预期修正开始与科技板块的盈利预期修正相匹配。

segments.en: We're showing also a really healthy market dispersion where we're seeing a little bit more broad-based rally coming to emerging markets.
segments.zh: 市场分化也很健康，我们看到新兴市场出现更广泛的上行。

segments.en: And the last layer is really India, I think India is the last kind of bastion in our view, the secular drivers of emerging market where we see productivity, population and consumption growth is still alive and valid and we believe that in the multi-year, multi-decade horizon they will prevail.
segments.zh: 最后一层是印度。我们认为印度是新兴市场长期驱动因素的最后堡垒，生产率、人口和消费增长依然有效，我们相信在多年乃至数十年的维度上它们会占上风。
